notes.summary: Flowise (acquired by Workday, Aug 2025) was sunset; the GitHub repo was archived read-only on 2026-08-13 and core-team support ended 2026-08-31, with no official successor named.
steps: Fork the FlowiseAI/Flowise repo to keep maintaining it internally; the sunset page encourages teams to fork or join community-led forks
Expect no fixes from upstream: the flowise npm packages and Docker images are marked deprecated and issues/PRs are locked
The code stays Apache 2.0 licensed and remains visible on GitHub, so existing self-hosted deployments can keep building on it

notes.summary: Cipher was renamed ByteRover CLI (npm byterover-cli, command brv, Elastic License 2.0); the campfirein/byterover-cli repo was then archived read-only on 2026-09-27, while ByteRover docs still present the CLI as the current product.
steps: Install the renamed package with npm install -g byterover-cli (or curl -fsSL https://byterover.dev/install.sh | sh) and verify with brv --version
Repoint clones with git remote set-url origin https://github.com/campfirein/byterover-cli.git; old Cipher code is on the legacy-cipher branch
Replace legacy brv push / brv pull with brv vc push / brv vc pull; brv space switch is deprecated in favour of brv vc clone or the web dashboard
Note the license change to Elastic License 2.0 before redistributing or offering it as a service

notes.summary: mem0-mcp-server was archived on 2026-03-24 and is no longer maintained; Mem0 now offers an official cloud-hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp.
steps: Replace the local uvx mem0-mcp-server entry with the remote HTTP server https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp in your MCP client config
Register it in one go with npx mcp-add --name mem0-mcp --type http --url "https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp" --clients "claude code,cursor" (list only clients you use)
Authenticate via the browser sign-in flow, or for headless clients send your Mem0 API key as a bearer token (e.g. Codex bearer_token_env_var = "MEM0_API_KEY")
Claude Desktop rejects mcp-add; add the URL under Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector instead

notes.summary: Not deprecated: openai/codex is not archived and ships frequent rust-v releases (e.g. rust-v0.142.x in June 2026); only the original TypeScript implementation was superseded by the native Rust CLI, which the plain @openai/codex npm package now installs.
The bytebot-ai/bytebot repo was archived read-only on 2026-03-07 with no README notice of shutdown, successor or migration; no official successor.
steps: No official migration steps are published; the README and docs.bytebot.ai carry no shutdown or successor notice
The repo has been read-only since 2026-03-07, so no further releases or fixes will land upstream

notes.summary: ByteRover the product is still documented as current (install via byterover.dev/install.sh or npm byterover-cli); only the open campfirein/byterover-cli GitHub repo was archived on 2026-09-27 (see the Cipher record).

Continue was acquired by Cursor (June 2026) and continuedev/continue is no longer actively maintained and read-only after a final 2.0.0 release; no official migration path for .continue/rules is named.
steps: Treat the final 2.0.0 release of the VS Code extension, CLI and JetBrains plugin as the last upstream version
JetBrains users are told to use the Continue CLI instead of the JetBrains plugin
The open-source codebase remains freely available, so teams that rely on .continue/rules can fork it

notes.summary: gpt-engineer was archived read-only on 2026-04-22; its README points managed-service users to gptengineer.app (Lovable) and CLI users to aider.
steps: For a managed service, move to gptengineer.app, which the README calls the opinionated, managed evolution (repo About says precursor to lovable.dev)
For a maintained hackable CLI, install aider with python -m pip install aider-install then aider-install
Run aider from your project directory, e.g. aider --model sonnet --api-key anthropic=<key>

notes.summary: Swarm's README says it is replaced by the OpenAI Agents SDK, a production-ready evolution, and recommends migrating for all production use (repo not archived).
steps: Install the SDK with pip install openai-agents (or uv add openai-agents) and set OPENAI_API_KEY
Replace Swarm imports with from agents import Agent, Runner and define agents with name and instructions
Declare delegation via the handoffs=[...] parameter, giving each specialist a handoff_description
Run with await Runner.run(agent, input) and read result.final_output

to: Sweep AI plugin for JetBrains IDEs
notes.summary: The sweepai/sweep repo is not archived, but its README says the team now builds an AI coding assistant for JetBrains; the GitHub-app product is no longer the focus.
steps: Open IDE plugin settings (Cmd/Ctrl + comma) and install Sweep AI from the JetBrains Marketplace
Restart the IDE and choose Sign In with Sweep, which redirects to the Sweep app
If sign-in fails, copy a token from app.sweep.dev and paste it into Sweep Settings in the Sweep sidebar

notes.summary: AutoGen is in maintenance mode (no new features, community managed); Microsoft directs new users to Microsoft Agent Framework and existing users to its AutoGen migration guide.
steps: Install Agent Framework (e.g. pip install agent-framework-foundry azure-identity) in place of autogen-agentchat / autogen-ext
Swap from autogen_agentchat.agents import AssistantAgent for from agent_framework import Agent, tool; FunctionTool becomes the @tool decorator
Replace autogen_ext OpenAIChatCompletionClient with agent_framework.openai OpenAIChatCompletionClient (Azure via azure_endpoint, api_version, credential)
Move conversation memory to AgentSession (agent.create_session(), pass session= to run()); persist state via session.state or history/context providers

notes.summary: Kuzu Inc archived kuzudb/kuzu read-only on 2025-10-10 ("Kuzu is working on something new") with a final 0.11.3 release and no official successor; the catalog record does not flag this.
steps: Pin to the final release 0.11.3, which bundles many (but not all) extensions
For extensions not bundled, run a local extension server as the archive notice suggests
Use the documentation now hosted on GitHub Pages at kuzudb.github.io/docs, since resources moved off the Kuzu website

notes.summary: DataStax acquired Langflow (Logspace) in April 2024 and IBM closed its DataStax acquisition on 2025-05-28, pledging continued open-source support; Langflow is still actively released (v1.11.4 tagged Aug 19), so nothing to migrate.
ClickHouse acquired Langfuse (announced 2026-01-16); Langfuse stays open source and self-hostable with no planned licensing changes and Cloud running as-is, so nothing to migrate.
Memary is not archived and its README has no deprecation or successor notice; it is merely dormant (last release v0.1.5, 2024-10-22), so there is no official migration path.

The README now says Semantic Kernel is now Microsoft Agent Framework, its enterprise-ready successor (1.0 GA); SK v1.x keeps getting critical bug and security fixes while new features go to Agent Framework.
steps: Python: replace semantic-kernel with agent-framework; C#: move from Microsoft.SemanticKernel(.Agents) to Microsoft.Agents.AI and Microsoft.Extensions.AI
Drop the Kernel: create agents from a chat client, e.g. chatClient.AsAIAgent(instructions: ...) in C# or Agent(client=..., instructions=...) in Python
Turn plugins into tools without [KernelFunction] (AIFunctionFactory.Create in C#, @tool in Python); .as_agent_framework_tool() wraps existing ones
Replace AgentThread with agent.create_session() / CreateSessionAsync() and InvokeAsync/invoke with RunAsync/run(input, session=session)

notes.summary: smol-ai/developer is not archived and its README has no deprecation, pivot or successor notice (it only lists community ports); the project is dormant, with no official migration path.

to: MongoDB Atlas Embedding and Reranking API
notes.summary: MongoDB announced the Voyage AI acquisition on 2025-02-24 and the models are still maintained; MongoDB documents an optional migration from api.voyageai.com to the Atlas Embedding and Reranking API but states no deprecation or deadline.
steps: In your Atlas project open AI Model APIs, click Create model API key, and set it as VOYAGE_API_KEY in place of the old Voyage key
If endpoints are hard-coded, swap https://api.voyageai.com/v1/... for https://ai.mongodb.com/v1/... (embeddings, rerank, multimodal, contextualized)
voyageai Python client 0.3.7+ routes by key format automatically; the TypeScript client needs environment: "https://ai.mongodb.com/v1"
Test embeddings and reranking, then delete the old key on the Voyage AI platform
